text:
Elaine: spotted short burst of CSRs to signing-service in eu-west at ~2026-03-18T03:12Z. requestor shows 'proxy-provisioner' which shouldn't call CA.
Kishore: paste CSR subject + thumbprint + audit line?
Elaine: subject=CN=svc.proxy.edge.eu-west, O=redwood; sha256=1f4b...; audit: `2026-03-18T03:12:05Z INFO RequestReceived uid=ac12 authn=proxy-provisioner region=eu-west action=create_csr`
opsec-bot: alert: csr-spike-eu-west — 5 events in 2m for pattern 'svc.proxy.edge.*' (rule: ephemeral-csr-spike). link:/alerts/7132467890
Samir: we put a tiny RBAC tweak at 02:45 to let proxy-provisioner create CSRs for canary proxies. could be glob mis-spec.
Kishore: I authored that change; intended CN pattern 'canary-*' but I might have used a broad wildcard.
Jason: did CA sign any? or were they just queued?
Elaine: two certs show signed=true with 1h TTL.
Kishore: immediate: revoke issued certs, tighten IAM rule, pull KMS:Decrypt logs for signing-key-eu-west, and collect policy-change timeline.
Samir: running revoke: `./signingctl revoke --region eu-west --selector "subject:svc.proxy.edge*" --reason "misissue"`
Elaine: revoke finished — 2 certs revoked. serials: 0x2f9d...,0x2f9e...
Kishore: forensics checklist: signing-service audit, KMS decrypt events (key=signing-key-eu-west), IAM policy delta, edge-proxy request traces (x-request-id).
Jason: prefer not to rotate root now. issue a new intermediate signed by root KMS key and switch issuance to new intermediate. lower blast radius.
Kishore: short-term hardening: enforce server-side CN pattern checks in signing-service, require caller token id in CSR, and log caller identity + SNI + source IP for every sign request.
Samir: I'll collate logs and package for incident. Elaine, can you pull proxy traces for those serials?
Elaine: pulling traces, will post in incident channel when ready.
Kishore: also add CI lint to validate IAM StringLike conditions on policy changes so globs are sanity-checked before apply.
Jason: follow-ups for post-mortem: 1) server-side CSR allowlist 2) telemetry metrics: csr.unexpected_count and csr.requestor_identity 3) auto-pause signing if >3 unexpected CSRs in 5m in a region.
opsec-bot: incident_created: incident/7132467890 — owners assigned: @samir @kishore @elaine. next update in 30m or on new findings. :lock:
